owner_creation.analysis: ch_ungotchar: The private c_uchar owns one pending pushback byte; ch_have_ungotchar separately determines whether that byte is meaningful.
owner_creation.invariant: Pushback payload is one inline byte, not an allocation.
limitations: The one-byte payload is reviewed with its validity/input relationship; no new observed pushback failure is claimed.

aliases_escapes.analysis: ch_ungotchar: ch_ungetchar copies its argument and ch_get copies the byte into a cache buffer; no pointer to the payload escapes.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Pushback transfers a value rather than a borrowed address.
limitations: The one-byte payload is reviewed with its validity/input relationship; no new observed pushback failure is claimed.

callback_targets.analysis: ch_ungotchar: An overrun calls error directly before replacing the value; diagnostics may reenter shared screen state but no function pointer is stored in the byte.
callback_targets.invariant: Overrun reporting is separate from byte storage.
limitations: The one-byte payload is reviewed with its validity/input relationship; no new observed pushback failure is claimed.

invalidation.analysis: ch_ungotchar: Consumption clears the availability flag, and file-state replacement does not by itself encode which input the global byte belongs to.
invalidation.invariant: Pushback validity requires the matching active input.
limitations: The one-byte payload is reviewed with its validity/input relationship; no new observed pushback failure is claimed.

mutation_commit.analysis: ch_ungotchar: Producer writes payload then sets the validity flag; consumer writes the cached byte then clears it, with no atomic pair or input identity.
mutation_commit.invariant: Payload and validity must be interpreted as one state.
limitations: The one-byte payload is reviewed with its validity/input relationship; no new observed pushback failure is claimed.

release_pair.analysis: ch_ungotchar: The byte is never freed; consumption retires its logical validity without releasing the destination cache buffer.
release_pair.invariant: Consuming pushback does not release cache ownership.
limitations: The one-byte payload is reviewed with its validity/input relationship; no new observed pushback failure is claimed.

error_cleanup.analysis: ch_ungotchar: The overrun path reports and then overwrites the payload; no typed error result preserves the previous logical pushback transaction.
error_cleanup.invariant: Pushback replacement has no failure-preserving result.
limitations: The one-byte payload is reviewed with its validity/input relationship; no new observed pushback failure is claimed.

signals_handoff.analysis: ch_ungotchar: Raw paired globals can be observed amid reentry or file transitions, leaving their owner relation in M0-MEM-001.
signals_handoff.invariant: Global payload lifetime is not an input-generation proof.
limitations: The one-byte payload is reviewed with its validity/input relationship; no new observed pushback failure is claimed.
